title: AWS Technical Essentials
abstract: Foundation to start building on AWS: navigate the Management Console, configure IAM security controls, deploy compute across EC2/Lambda/containers, set up RDS and DynamoDB, manage S3 storage, explore networking, monitor with CloudWatch. Hands-on labs per topic. Foundational (100).

title: AI Powered Business Intelligence with Amazon Quick
abstract: Amazon Quick brings AI-powered analytics, automation, and research into a single workspace. Build interactive dashboards with Quick Sight, organize team knowledge in Spaces with permissions, create custom Chat Agents to surface insights conversationally, automate workflows with Quick Flows, conduct multi-source research with validation. Three hands-on labs.

title: AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC)
abstract: The AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) reimagines how teams plan, build, and ship software with AI as a first-class participant. Learn the three phases (Inception, Construction, Operation), apply the Intent-Unit-Bolt framework to decompose requirements into AI-executable work items, then use Kiro IDE's Spec-Driven Development to generate domain models, code, tests, and infrastructure. Leave with a working application built entirely through AI-DLC. favorites lens: Kiro + spec-driven, directly the haunting's development methodology.

title: Agentic Modernization with AWS Transform
abstract: AWS Transform orchestrates AI agents that analyze, refactor, and convert legacy applications without manual line-by-line rewrites. Set modernization objectives, let AI agents decompose and transform .NET Framework code to cross-platform .NET on Linux, migrate a SQL Server database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Practice agentic assessment, wave planning, code transformation, schema conversion end to end. favorites lens: the same AWS Transform agentic-modernization pattern seen in MAM206.

title: Become an AWS AI Business Strategist
abstract: Turning an AI idea into enterprise reality requires more than technical knowledge. Apply the Discover, Design, Deliver framework to diagnose business problems, assess organizational readiness, scope AI pilots with clear success criteria. Navigate responsible-AI tradeoffs, lead change management, evaluate agentic AI architectures for autonomy vs control, build phased scaling from POC through production. Foundational (100).

title: Spec-Driven AI Development with Kiro
abstract: The AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) brings structure, traceability, and human oversight to high-velocity agentic-AI software delivery. Apply AI-DLC in Kiro to build a production application through Feature Specs, control agent behavior with steering files and execution modes, extend capabilities with MCP servers and Kiro Powers, automate workflows with hooks. Leave with a governed, repeatable process. favorites lens: Kiro steering files, MCP servers, and hooks are exactly the haunting's stack.

title: Resilient Cloud Ops: From IaC to Fault Injection
abstract: Production infrastructure needs repeatable deployment and proven resilience. Use AWS CDK and CloudFormation to define and provision cloud resources as code, eliminating drift. Then validate under stress: troubleshoot VPC connectivity using flow logs, inject controlled faults with AWS Fault Injection Service, confirm graceful recovery. Deploy it right, then prove it holds.

title: AWS Partner: Agentic AI workflows for business users on Amazon Quick
abstract: AWS Partners only. Hands-on business scenario using Amazon Quick, the agentic AI workspace that connects to your tools and learns your workflows. Create knowledge spaces, run deep-research agents, connect external APIs, automate multi-step processes with Flows, build a custom AI agent in a browser. Leave able to help customers put agentic AI to work.

title: Agentic Powered AWS Frontier Agents
abstract: Application failures and security vulnerabilities demand fast answers. Set up AWS DevOps Agent to automate investigation through logs, metrics, and code changes, then generate remediation plans. Use AWS Security Agent to configure domain-scoped penetration tests, monitor real-time execution, interpret severity-rated findings. Two agents that compress hours of investigation into minutes. favorites lens: agent-driven investigation + remediation, the haunting's dispatch pattern.

title: AWS Partner: Ship an AI agent without crossing your fingers
abstract: AWS Partners only. AI agents work in demos but break in production. Replace luck with observability. Prototype a role-based agent with the Strands SDK. Evaluate with custom evaluators for quality and compliance. Deploy to production on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Observe with OpenTelemetry tracing and CloudWatch dashboards. Detect drift by evaluating production traffic at scale. favorites lens: OTEL tracing of agents pairs with the otel-monitor poltergeist work.

title: AWS Partner: Your agent can wait. Go fix the app it depends on.
abstract: AWS Partners only. An agent is only as reliable as the services it calls. Before you fix anything, know exactly what's broken. Stress-test a service for gaps that break autonomous invocation, read findings against your own predictions, make the call on what to fix first. Leave with a ranked fix list and a transferable method.

title: Build AI-Powered Contact Center Agents with Amazon Connect
abstract: Customer-facing AI Agents can resolve issues end-to-end. Build two complementary AI agents on Amazon Connect AI Customer: an agent-assistance copilot that watches live chats and surfaces real-time knowledge base answers and customer data, and a self-service AI agent that handles routine requests autonomously using MCP tools for Cases and Customer Profiles, with structured escalation preserving conversation context.

title: AWS Partner: Build AI workflows that laugh in the face of disruption
abstract: AWS Partners only. AI workflows fail in ways that don't show up until production: a human misses a deadline, an external system says no, a sub-workflow loses state mid-flight. Combine Step Functions, Lambda durable functions, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore into a three-layer stack that routes decisions, checkpoints execution, and reasons through uncertainty. Run scenarios through the Simulator Panel, trace every layer live. favorites lens: durable multi-layer agent orchestration, the haunting's delegation-chain concern.

title: Building Advanced Agentic AI Systems on AWS
abstract: Multi-agent systems unlock powerful workflows, but production demands more than chaining agents. Advanced patterns using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: agent-as-tool communication, shared memory across agents, context-window optimization for cost and performance, policy-based access control, VPC integration, distributed tracing, evaluation frameworks, deployment strategies from prototype to production. favorites lens: agent-as-tool + shared memory + context-window optimization is the exact haunting dispatch architecture.

title: AWS Partner: Build the AgentCore agent your demo pretends to be
abstract: AWS Partners only. A good prompt gets you a chatbot; everything else on AgentCore turns it into an agent. Build a customer support agent from scratch and progressively add persistent memory, tools through Gateway to reach real data, Cedar policies that enforce boundaries, plus production traces, quality evaluations, AI-driven optimization with A/B testing. favorites lens: persistent memory + policy-enforced boundaries + tracing, the haunting agent shape.

title: AWS Partner: Govern AI agents by hacking one first
abstract: AWS Partners only. Exploit a live AI agent with a prompt injection attack that approves a fraudulent transaction, then defend it. Fix with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to block prompt attacks and PII leaks. Verify controls with AWS Config conformance packs, find ungoverned AI resources with Resource Explorer. Observe agent decisions and guardrail interventions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. favorites lens: prompt-injection defense + governance gates, directly the haunting's agent-governance concern.
